Field testing documentation · BIT Mesra Polytechnic

Drone Field Testing
& Practical Demonstration

RAKSHAK Aerial Unit — an X4 Carbon Fiber Quadcopter concept described for post-disaster search-and-rescue operations, with an RF-Free autonomous platform and Edge AI. Field testing and practical demonstration were conducted at BIT Mesra Polytechnic, Mesra, Ranchi, by Ashish Kumar, Founder & Director of MVA Robotics Innovation Org, his team, and Mr Abhinav, the organisation’s drone training provider.

Project technical profile

Hardware & system architecture

Technical terms and figures below are carried over from the original RAKSHAK Aerial Unit description supplied by the user; they have not been independently verified from the photographs.

Hardware specifications

Platform / frameX4 Carbon Fiber Quadcopter
Flight controllerPX4 / Pixhawk 6C
Endurance30 minutes (stated)
Operating range5 km LoRa Mesh (stated)
Weight1.8 kg without payload (stated)
Environmental ratingIP45 field-ready (stated)

System & autonomy

Edge AIYOLOv8 Nano human detection
Compute platformNVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano
Sensor suiteRGB + thermal fusion
CommunicationsLoRa 868 MHz mesh network
Control integrationRUDRA Control Station
Operating capabilityRF-free and GPS-denied operation (stated)

Intended mission

The supplied project description positions RAKSHAK for post-disaster search and rescue, using edge-based human detection and a communications mesh. Actual autonomous, RF-free, GPS-denied, thermal-fusion, and flight-performance capabilities should be confirmed against the final system configuration and test records before publication as validated results.

Agreement summary

The supplied MoU describes a partnership for drone training and kit supply. It identifies MVA Robotics Innovation Org as the first party, represented by Ashish Kumar, Founder & Director, and identifies ITS Service as the second party and official drone training and kit provider for MVA Robotics Innovation Org, represented by Mr Abhinav.
